items.item_text: High school diploma and/or equivalent education/experience
Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, collective bargaining agreements, and regulations related to leaves, including legal entitlements.
Experience in leave of absence case management
Experience using automated HR/payroll/personnel and financial systems.
Experience using advanced software programs/features such as Microsoft applications, i.e. Excel, Word and Access.

Under the direction of the Leaves Supervisor and HR Manager, administer leave of absence (industrial & non-industrial) and workers’ compensation programs for Shared Services Center clients. Advise on and process leave of absences; provide analytical support services to managers, supervisors, employees and payroll staff.
Analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills to effectively work with diverse populations at all levels of the organization.
Knowledge of medical separation and reasonable accommodation guidelines, policies and procedures.
Knowledge of the University’s personnel policies, procedures and labor contracts.
Skill to work with frequent interruptions and to handle multiple projects, activities and deadlines simultaneously, especially during peak periods
Skill to maintain confidentiality of personnel or other sensitive issues/matters and exercise independent judgment and discretion in dealing with controversial or potentially sensitive topics.
